study type: Prospective model development study (using a dataset from the ASPRE study)
cohort: The study included 185 normal pregnancies and 20 GDM cases from a first trimester dataset of the ASPRE study.
finding: A new first trimester prediction model for GDM was developed, showing high accuracy (AUC of 0.95 in obese women and 0.94 in non-obese women) using a combination of clinical and biochemical biomarkers.
followup_time: GDM diagnosis occurs later in pregnancy, after the first trimester biomarker collection.
gest_age: Biomarker levels were transformed to gestational week-specific medians (MoMs), indicating gestational age was considered in the analysis.
